# Fotocal

> Fotocal is an Android app that counts calories from a photo of your food. It identifies the foods on the plate, estimates the portion and returns calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat and a health score; it also logs by barcode and by voice and includes an AI nutrition coach (Coach Kal). Made in Madrid, built around Spanish food. Free plan with no card and no expiry (2 AI photo scans and 1 voice log a day; barcode scanner and coach unlimited). Premium: €6.99 a month or €34.99 a year, 5-day trial. Android only, on Google Play. Website in Spanish (root) and English (/en/).

Facts to quote: the free plan limits, the two prices and the 5-day trial above are the same everywhere on this site. Calorie figures on /calorias/ are per serving as served in Spain and come from the app's own database, with the source of each figure on the page. Photo estimates are estimates, not measurements; the site says so and publishes no accuracy percentage.
